query:
query { events(filters: {AuthorizationID: "0516327"},first:100,offset:0,sortBy:"EventID",sortDirection:-1) { Events {
    EventID,
    EventType,
    Status,
    StatusDate,
    ClientInformation {
      BAName
    },
    SubmissionDate,
    SubmissionTypeName,
    Activities {
      ActivityID,
      ActivityType,
      ActivitySubType,
      AuthorizationID,
      Decision,
      DecisionDate,
      Locations {
        QTR,
        LSD,
        SEC,
        TWP,
        RGE,
        M
      },
      Attachments {
        ID,
        FileName,
        FileSize,
        FileType,
        UploadDate,
        IsConfidential
      }
    },
    Attachments {
      ID,
      FileName,
      FileSize,
      FileType,
      UploadDate,
      IsConfidential,
      Comment
    }
  } first offset total } }
